entries.title: Penumbra: Overture

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build and community fixes if needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with compatibility-wrapper options.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because Penumbra: Overture shipped only on desktop platforms and PC offers the strongest capture/settings compatibility path.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Penumbra: Overture or the Penumbra Collectors Pack on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Check for any modern Windows fixes.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster/remake distinction applies; the collector package is a distribution bundle.

entries.title: Penumbra: Requiem
entries.definitive_edition: Black Plague Gold Edition / Penumbra Collectors Pack

emulation.notes: Use the native PC package that includes Requiem.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with compatibility-wrapper options.

primary.version: Black Plague Gold Edition / Penumbra Collectors Pack
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best way to play Requiem because it is an expansion to Black Plague, shipped on desktop platforms, and is packaged in the modern Black Plague Gold/collector releases.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Penumbra: Black Plague Gold Edition or the Penumbra Collectors Pack on Steam and play Requiem on Windows PC after Black Plague.

entries.remaster_caveats: Requiem is an expansion to Black Plague, not a standalone numbered sequel or remake.
